newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Firm to announce Hock Hua unit takeover.
newsitem.headline: Firm to announce Hock Hua unit takeover.

text.p: Hock Hua Bank Bhd will hold a news conference on Wednesday to announce details of the takeover of its Sabah state unit by private firm Langkah Bahagia Sdn Bhd.

Langkah Bahagia director Mohd Nasir Ali, one of the parties involved in the takeover, said in a statement the meeting at Kuala Lumpur's Pan Pacific Hotel will begin with a signing ceremony at 1600 local time (0800 GMT).

Deputy Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim had said in November last year that the government's economic adviser, Daim Zainuddin, and his associates had been granted permission to negotiate for the take over of a 70.7 percent subsidiary of Hock Hua Bank, the Hock Hua Bank (Sabah) Bhd.
Hock Hua shares were suspended from Wednesday trading, after closing at 11.70 ringgit a share on Tuesday.
